origine_fr: À gauche, 讠, la parole ; à droite, 己, qui donne le son (jǐ). Ce qu'on met en mots pour le retenir. C'est noter, se souvenir.
origine_en: On the left, 讠, speech; on the right, 己, which gives the sound (jǐ). What you put into words so you can keep it. It means to note down, to remember.

phrase.fr: Il tient son journal tous les jours.
phrase.en: He writes in his diary every day.
